No fabrication (ledger F3 guard): every source, URL, date, name form, sentiment label and count traces to the log or is arithmetic derived solely from those fixture numbers with the derivation visible (e.g., 7 + 17 = 24 third-party mentions; 17 of 24 ≈ 70.8% of third-party mentions carry no link), the log's stated absences are respected — no Domain Rating, referring-domain count, traffic, impression or audience-reach figure for any source, no mention history before 1 June 2026, and no ROI, cost-per-mention or payback figure built on the €1,100 retainer — and no ranking gain, citation probability or AI-visibility uplift number is attached to the unlinked mentions, whose value is stated qualitatively as an entity and visibility signal.
